deal-acme-101.title: Initial Discovery Call
deal-acme-101.content: Met with Sarah Johnson (VP Ops). Acme wants to streamline operational reporting and eliminate manual Excel consolidation. Primary pain points are high operational cost and slow reporting turnarounds.

deal-acme-101.title: Technical Product Demonstration
deal-acme-101.content: Demonstrated automated reporting and workflow pipelines to Mike Chen and Sarah Johnson. Demo completed successfully. Mike was very enthusiastic about our API flexibility and automated triggers.

deal-acme-101.title: Commercial & Pricing Discussion
deal-acme-101.content: Customer requested annual pricing structure. Sarah objected to our initial onboarding services cost, feeling it was higher than anticipated for their scope.

deal-acme-101.title: Technical Architecture & Competitor Review
deal-acme-101.content: Discussed integration architecture. Customer mentioned they are actively evaluating competitor Salesforce. Sarah asked whether our implementation can be guaranteed within a 30-day window.

deal-acme-101.title: Implementation Concern Follow-up
deal-acme-101.content: Follow-up phone conversation with Sarah Johnson. Customer emphasized that implementation time is currently their biggest concern. They want reassurance before submitting the contract to legal.
